cards.name: Summer Camps
cards.description: Participants rehearse a JR or KIDS musical adaptation and perform it over one weekend. Youth also make props, build sets, design costumes, and operate lights, sound and backstage roles.

prices.label: No enrollment, participation or materials fees

cards.review_notes: The 2026 policies identify Shrek the Musical KIDS as the summer production; the theatre FAQ gives Shrek KIDS eligibility as K–12. The page describes two weeks of rehearsals plus a performance weekend but provides no readable dates or hours. Verify the embedded season images and audition PDFs for the 2027 offering and whether rehearsals are daytime.

cards.name: Page to Stage
cards.description: Participants attend guest workshops and write, direct, costume, provide technical support for, and produce their own short plays. The program lasts one week and concludes with four performances over a weekend.

prices.label: No enrollment, participation or materials fees

cards.review_notes: The official search-indexed 2026 policies identify Page to Stage as the one-week summer intensive. No readable session dates, hours or registration milestones were found.
